name: Walker
author: brodgar
description: Example addon: the protected write tier, one deliberate verb at a time. It declares a permission key per verb it fires -- some as a '<prefix>.*' group -- so it is disabled by default and enabling it asks for your consent, showing exactly what it asked for; each ':walker <sub>' fires exactly one protected verb -- walking, clicking, the held-item gesture, placing and area-selecting, the item verbs, the escape hatch on a bound widget, plus the writes on the movement speed, the crafting recipe, the action bar, the action menu, the kin roster and the radial menu's own petal selection.
